name: write-only-type-member
description: A property of an object literal writes the member its contextual type declares under that name, whether or not the compiler checks the literal for excess properties. A type member a literal annotated with its type writes and production code never reads is reported as write-only, so is one a callback's literal writes through a type argument, and so is one only a test file reads; a member nothing writes or reads is reported as an unused member, and the members production code reads are reported under no code.
